plans.note: Separate caps for each party (9.1 IBM, 9.2 Customer) — check cap amount/multiple, mutuality, consequential-damages waiver and carve-outs (IP indemnity, confidentiality, data breach, gross negligence). 14.14 Actions Period may shorten our claim window.

Vendor indemnity in 8.1 — confirm third-party IP infringement plus personal injury/property damage and data breach; 8.2 Customer indemnity should be narrowed to our content/AUP breach; sec-1 appears to be the indemnity procedure conditions (notice/control/cooperation).

No non-compete heading; 14.16 Freedom of Action is typically vendor-favourable rather than restrictive on us, but confirm 14.11 No Resale and 13.2 AUP do not restrict lines of business we may operate.
Check 14.16 and the services/no-resale clauses for any sole-source or exclusive-provider language; if only IBM reserves freedom of action, flag asymmetry but no exclusivity binds us.
No pricing-parity heading; scan 4.1 Charges for any best-terms or price-matching obligation running against us.

14.8 Personnel is the likely home for a hiring/solicitation restriction — verify mutuality, term length (12 months max), scope limited to personnel engaged on the services, and a general-advertising carve-out.

3.4 Termination for Convenience — check whether the right is mutual or IBM-only, the notice period, and any termination/early-exit charges (may cross-reference 4.1 Charges); 3.3 cause rights and cure period; 3.5 for consequences.

3.2 Renewal — confirm whether renewal is automatic, the non-renewal notice window (target 30 days, cap at 60) and whether renewal pricing is capped or uplifted at IBM's discretion; 3.1 for the initial term baseline.
14.3 Choice of Law (confirm NY/DE/CA/E&W and a courts venue, not foreign arbitration); 14.4 jury-trial waiver and 14.14 Actions Period are related procedural terms to review.

14.10 Assignment — secure our right to assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger/asset sale without consent, and ensure IBM cannot terminate on our change of control; check any consent condition is mutual.

12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses govern IP ownership/grant direction; confirm we retain ownership of our Content/data (11.6, 14.18) and that nothing assigns our IP or data to IBM; 3.5 for data rights at termination.

12.1 is the grant — check it extends to our affiliates and contractors/users, is non-revocable during the term, and that 14.17's limitations do not narrow it below our use case; 12.2 covers Base Component maintenance.

11.3 Suspected Violations is the likely inspection/investigation right against us — impose notice, business-hours, frequency limits, off-site review where possible and IBM's cost; 13.2 AUP and 11.5 Capacity Planning may supply monitoring hooks.

Look for late-payment interest or overage/penalty charges in 4.2 and 4.1 payable by us; no service-credit or SLA remedy section appears in the outline — flag the absence of credits in our favour (11.1 Services Support).

5.1 IBM warranties plus 5.2 exclusivity-of-warranties and 5.4 disclaimers (likely broad AS-IS language to push back on); confirm a meaningful performance warranty with a repair/re-perform or refund remedy; 11.2 contains our reciprocal warranties, 5.3 security.

No insurance section in the outline; since IBM hosts our data (5.3, 14.18) we should add commercial general liability, cyber/tech E&O and crime coverage with certificates — 14.12 Risk of Loss is the nearest adjacent term.

Check 4.1 Charges (and any Order Form/Service Option Attachment cross-references) for minimum commitments, committed capacity or take-or-pay volumes; 11.5 Capacity Planning may force committed forecasts; pair any commitment with the 3.4 exit right.

3.5 Effect of Termination is the place to secure data return in a usable format, a wind-down/transition assistance period at agreed rates, and deletion certification; confirm those obligations survive under 14.2.
